note: This file is a MMDetection configuration dictionary only. It defines a `model` variable as a nested dict with no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It is consumed by the MMDetection framework to instantiate a Faster R-CNN (ResNet-50 + FPN) object detection model. No CLI-callable code exists in this file.
summarize_model_config: summarize the Faster R-CNN ResNet-50 FPN model configuration dictionary
review_model_config: review the Faster R-CNN model config including backbone, neck, RPN head, and RoI head settings
build_faster_rcnn_model: build a Faster R-CNN object detection model using the ResNet-50 FPN config from MMDetection
test_faster_rcnn_config: test the Faster R-CNN ResNet-50 FPN model configuration for correctness before training
refactor_model_config: refactor the Faster R-CNN model config to change backbone depth or number of classes
